description: This Java class defines an Android Fragment that demonstrates how to toggle various immersive fullscreen UI modes, including hiding navigation and status bars, and adjusting UI flag settings through checkbox controls and button interactions.

classes.name: AdvancedImmersiveModeFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that provides UI controls for toggling immersive mode and related UI visibility flags.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, enabling options menu.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the UI layout, initializes checkboxes and buttons, and sets up the click listeners to toggle immersive mode presets.

methods.name: dumpFlagStateToLog
methods.description: Logging helper method that outputs the current state of various system UI flags.

methods.name: toggleUiFlags
methods.description: Method to read checkbox states and compose the appropriate system UI flags to toggle immersive mode settings accordingly.
